description:
Get UTXO block details (Block Data product).

Actions:
• get-block-by-height: Get block details by block height (number)
• get-block-by-hash: Get block details by block hash
• list-transactions-by-block-height: List transactions in a block by block height
• list-transactions-by-block-hash: List transactions in a block by block hash
• get-last-mined-block: Get the latest mined block details
• list-latest-mined-blocks: List the latest mined blocks

Blockchain → Networks:
• bitcoin: mainnet, testnet
• bitcoin-cash: mainnet, testnet
• litecoin: mainnet, testnet
• dogecoin: mainnet, testnet
• dash: mainnet, testnet
• zcash: mainnet, testnet

Credits by action (source: OpenAPI):
• get-block-by-hash: bitcoin 20, bitcoin-cash 24, dash 22, dogecoin 22, litecoin 22, zcash 26
• get-block-by-height: bitcoin 20, bitcoin-cash 24, dash 22, dogecoin 22, litecoin 22, zcash 26
• get-last-mined-block: bitcoin 20, bitcoin-cash 24, dash 22, dogecoin 22, litecoin 22, zcash 26
• list-latest-mined-blocks: bitcoin 20, bitcoin-cash 24, dash 22, dogecoin 22, litecoin 22, zcash 26
• list-transactions-by-block-hash: bitcoin 20, bitcoin-cash 24, dash 22, dogecoin 22, litecoin 22, zcash 26
• list-transactions-by-block-height: bitcoin 20, bitcoin-cash 24, dash 22, dogecoin 22, litecoin 22, zcash 26

Credits are indicative only and may change at any time. The actual credits spent for each API request are returned in the response headers.
